# Recording remux fixture

`recording-h264.mp4` is a 3,316-byte, one-second 160 × 128 H.264 clip containing
60 encoded video packets at 60 FPS. It was generated by this application's
native NVENC smoke test and is retained as an intentional test input.

`tests/recording_services.test.mjs` uses it to verify the pinned browser muxer
and compressed-payload limits. The test performs remuxing in memory and creates
no output files. No GPU or codec installation is needed to run this test.
